parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right handle switch of the faucet, typically used to control hot water flow. It is made of stainless steel and has a cross-shaped design for easy grip.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates the flow of hot water by rotating clockwise or counterclockwise to open or close the valve.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its vertical axis to control water flow.

parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left handle switch of the faucet, typically used to control cold water flow. It is made of stainless steel and has a cross-shaped design.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates the flow of cold water by rotating clockwise or counterclockwise to open or close the valve.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its vertical axis to control water flow.

parts.name: Frame (Base Plate)
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the faucet that supports the spout and switches. It is made of stainless steel and provides structural stability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the faucet assembly together and connects it to the sink surface, ensuring water-tight installation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the mixed water from the internal valves to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally depending on the faucet design, allowing directional control of water flow.
